title: Speech by the Chairman of the Fair Competition Commission (FCC) during the opening of the Seminar on Competition Issues, Consumer Protection, and Control of Counterfeit Goods for Business and 5Economic Editors at the FCC Offices in Dar es Salaam on April 13, 2023.
title_sw: HOTUBA YA MWENYEKITI WA FCC WAKATI WA UFUNGUZI WA SEMINA YA MASUALA YA USHINDANI, KUMLINDA MLAJI NA UDHIBITI WA BIDHAA BANDIA KWA WAHARIRI WA HABARI ZA BIASHARA NA UCHUMI KATIKA OFISI YA FCC JIJINI DAR ES SALAAM TAREHE 13 APRILI, 2023.
text:
HOTUBA YA MWENYEKITI WA FCC WAKATI WA UFUNGUZI WA
SEMINA YA MASUALA YA USHINDANI, KUMLINDA MLAJI NA
UDHIBITI WA BIDHAA BANDIA KWA WAHARIRI WA HABARI ZA
BIASHARA NA UCHUMI KATIKA OFISI YA FCC JIJINI DAR ES
SALAAM TAREHE 13 APRILI, 2023.
Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa FCC,
Mwenyekiti wa Jukwaa la Wahariri,
Mjumbe wa Kamati tendaji ya Jukwaa la Wahariri,
Wafanyakazi wa FCC,
Wahariri wa vyombo mbalimbali vya habari,
Waandishi wa habari waandamizi kutoka vyombo mbalimbali vya
habari,
Wanahabari,
Wageni waalikwa,
Mabibi na Mabwana.
Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania!
Naomba nianze kwa kumshukuru Mwenyezi Mungu mwingi wa
rehema na fadhili kwa kutuwezesha kukutana siku hii tukiwa wazima
na wenye afya njema. Aidha, nitumie fursa hii kuwashukuru ninyi
nyote kwa dhati kabisa kwa kuitikia wito wetu na kujitokeza kwa wingi
kujumuika nasi katika semina hii, ni dhahiri mmeamua kuipa
umuhimu shughuli inayohusu sekta ya habari na majukumu yetu ya
kitaasisi kwa maslahi mapana ya mlaji. Hivyo basi, kwa niaba ya
1

watumishi wenzangu wa Tume ya Ushindani nawashukuru sana kwa
kuja kushiriki nasi katika semina hii fupi.
Tumeamua kufanya semina hii kwa madhumuni makubwa mawili;
Kwanza, kwa kutambua umuhimu wenu na nafasi zenu katika
vyombo vya habari kama wahariri na waandishi waandamizi wa
habari, sisi FCC ndio shughuli yetu hiyo, kwahiyo tulidhani kwanza
kuwajengea uwezo na kuwaongezea uelewa wenu wa shughuli za
biashara na uchumi ambazo FCC tunazisimamia kwa karibu, na
tunafikiri kwamba baada ya kumaliza mkutano huu tutakuwa
tumefanikiwa kwa kiwango kikubwa katika kufanikisha hilo.
Pili, tunataka kupitia kwenu kuujulisha Umma wa watanzania kuhusu
shughuli mbalimbali zinazohusiana na FCC na kwa namna gani
wanaweza kuzitumia katika kupata huduma stahiki kama ambavyo
wanazilipia, kwamba kile wanachokipata ndicho walichostahili
kukipata.
Katika mkutano wetu wa leo, nitaeleza kwa kifupi majukumu ya FCC,
wenzangu wataeleza kwa kina lakini kimsingi shughuli zetu kubwa ni
mbili;
Kwanza, ni kukuza na kulinda Ushindani wa kibiashara hapa nchini
na si kuzuia. Katika kulinda kama mnavyojua nchi yetu ya Tanzania
iliingia katika mfumo wa uchumi wa biashara huria tangu mwaka
1980, biashara huria haimaanishi watu wafanye mambo kiholela kwa
kufanya vurugu, wao wenyewe kwa wenyewe kuhujumiana lakini
2

kuhakikisha kwamba pia wanapata faida kubwa iwezekanavyo wakati
mwingine kwa kumtesa mlaji.
Sisi kama FCC kazi yetu ni kuratibu na kuangalia shughuli hizi kwa
karibu ili kuhakikisha kwamba chochote kinachofanywa hakikiuki
misingi ya ushindani na kila aliyeingia katika soko la ushindani wa
biashara basi anapata matunda ya kile kinachostahiki na faida
aliyoitegemea kwa kufanya biashara katika misingi ya haki na sahihi.
Pamoja na kukuza na kulinda shughuli za biashara katika nchi yetu,
pia tuna jukumu la kumlinda mlaji wa shughuli hizo za biashara
ambapo ndio sehemu kubwa ya watanzania ambao ndio wapiga kura
wanaoiweka Serikali madarakani. Kazi yetu ni kuahakikisha wapiga
kura au wananchi hao wanapata matarajio waliyoyakusudia na kile
ambacho wanakipata kinawaonesha kwamba kweli Serikali yao
imewajali na wanapata vitu ambavyo ni sahihi.
Sasa na hilo nalo ni kazi yetu kwasababu wafanyabiashara kwa hulka
yao na ndio maana ya biashara, kazi yao kubwa ni kupata faida, faida
hiyo inaweza kupatikana kwa njia zisizo halali au kwa njia halali ama
wakati mwingine kwa njia za kupigana vita, kuhujumiana wenyewe
kwa wenyewe, kuhujumiana kati yao na walaji na wasambazaji wa
kati, kwahiyo hapo ndipo FCC tunahakikisha mambo hayo
hayajitokezi na biashara zinashamiri ili kuwavutia wawekezaji katika
nchi yetu.
Sasa hayo ndio mtakayosikia kwetu, matumaini yetu kuwa
mtakapotoka katika semina hii na uelewa mtakaokuwa nao, basi
kupitia vyombo vyenu naamini mtatoa elimu stahiki kwa watanzania ili
3

baadaye sisi na ninyi kwa pamoja tuweze kuhakikisha kwamba
uendeshaji wa shughuli za biashara unakuwa wa haki na unazingatia
misingi iliyokubalika kwa mujibu wa sheria, kanuni na taratibu za
kufanya biashara katika soko la huria.
Ndugu wahariri, kupitia mkutano wetu wa leo mtapata mada tatu, ya
kwanza itakuwa udhibiti wa bidhaa bandia, ni dhahiri ninyi nyote
mnafahamu Serikali ya awamu ya sita imejikita katika kuhimiza
wawekezaji ili waje kuwekeza katika nchi yetu, sasa kunapokuwa na
uwekezaji hususan katika sekta ya viwanda na uzalishaji lazima uwe
na uhakika kwamba kwanza uwekezaji ule utakupa faida
unayostahili, na kufanya hivyo lazima mazingira ya kufanya biashara
katika nchi yetu yawe salama na yanazingatia kanuni za kibiashara
za kimataifa. Kwahiyo, sisi FCC tunafanya hilo ili kuwavutia
wawekezaji zaidi na wale ambao tayari wapo kuhakikisha kwamba
wanafanya biashara bila kubugudhiwa kwa namna yoyote ile na
washindani wenzao, lakini pia wanapata huduma wanazostahiki
kuwawezesha kufanya biashara kwa wakati.
Hivyo basi, FCC tunataka kuangalia hilo lakini pia hatuwezi kufanya
hilo kama tutaruhusu kushamiri kwa bidhaa bandia.
Aidha, katika semina hii mtaelezwa pia masuala ya bidhaa bandia
kwa maana ya dhana, aina, utambuzi na athari zake katika uchumi
wa nchi yetu. Sasa hayo yote yanakwenda kwa pamoja katika
kuimarisha biashara ya ushindani na kuhakikisha bidhaa bandia
haziingii nchini au hazizalishwi na hivyo kuzuia uwekezaji usifanikiwe
4

lakini pia kumlinda mwekezaji dhidi ya athari zinazoweza kutokana na
hali hiyo.
Ndugu wahariri, naomba nitumie fursa hii kuwafahamisha kuwa
sasa FCC tumefungua ofisi za Kanda ya Ziwa Mwanza iliyopo katika
jengo la PSSSF, ghorofa ya pili, barabara ya Kenyatta, Kanda ya
Kaskazini Arusha iliyopo AICC, jengo la Serengeti ghorofa ya tano
pamoja na Kanda ya Nyanda za Juu Kusini Mbeya iliyopo katika
jengo la NSSF ghorofa ya chini, mtaa wa Sisimba barabara ya
Karume. Lengo kuu la ufunguzi wa ofisi hizi ni kusogeza huduma
karibu na wananchi, hivyo ni rai yangu kwenu kutumia weredi na
nyenzo za kitaaluma mlizonazo kutusaidia kuujulisha Umma wa
Tanzania uwepo wa ofisi hizi sanjali na mjukumu tunayoyatekeleza
kwa mujibu wa sheria.
Baada ya kusema hayo, nimalizie kwa kuwasihi sana kuendelea
kuzingatia weledi na maadili ya taaluma yenu katika kuwahudumia
watanzania na wadau wote wa maendeleo ili kwa pamoja kuunga
mkono jitihada zinazofanywa na Serikali katika kuleta maendeleo
katika Taifa letu.
Nawatakia Semina njema na sasa natamka kuwa Semina hii
imefunguliwa rasmi.
Asanteni sana kwa kunisikiliza!
Speech by the Chairman of the Fair Competition Commission (FCC)
during the opening of the Seminar on Competition Issues, Consumer
Protection, and Control of Counterfeit Goods for Business and
5

Economic Editors at the FCC Offices in Dar es Salaam on April 13,
2023.
Director-General of the FCC,
Chairman of the Editors' Forum,
Member of the Executive Committee of the Editors' Forum,
FCC Staff,
Editors from various media outlets,
Senior journalists from various media outlets,
Journalists,
Invited Guests,
Ladies and Gentlemen.
I would like to extend the Almighty God, full of mercy and grace, for
enabling us to meet on this day in good health. I also want to
sincerely thank all of you for responding to our invitation and turning
out in large numbers to join us in this seminar. It is evident that you
have decided to give importance to activities related to the media
sector and our institutional responsibilities for the broader benefit of
consumers. Therefore, on behalf of my fellow staff at the Fair
Competition Commission, I express my sincere gratitude for your
active participation in this short seminar.
6

We have decided to hold this seminar with two main purposes;
First, recognizing your importance and roles in the media as editors
and senior journalists, our role at the FCC is to closely monitor these
activities. Therefore, we thought it wise to first enhance your capacity
and increase your understanding of business and economic activities
that the FCC closely oversees. We believe that, after completing this
meeting, we will have achieved significant success in that regard.
Second, you as a bridge for information, we want to inform the
Tanzanian public about various activities related to the FCC and how
they can utilize them to receive appropriate services as they pay for
them. What they receive should reflect what they are entitled to.
In our meeting today, I will briefly explain the responsibilities of the
FCC, while my colleagues will delve deeper. In essence, our major
tasks are two-fold;
Firstly, to promote and protect fair competition in the country, not to
hinder it. As you know, our country, Tanzania, entered the free-
market economic system in 1980. Free trade does not mean people
should engage in chaotic and disruptive activities, undermining each
other and causing harm. It means ensuring that everyone benefits as
much as possible while conducting business. As the FCC, our task is
to coordinate and closely monitor these activities to ensure that
nothing violates the principles of competition. Every participant in the
business competition should reap the fruits they deserve, engaging in
fair and just trade.
7

Alongside promoting and protecting business activities in our country,
we also have the responsibility to protect the consumers of these
business activities. They constitute the majority of Tanzanians, the
same individuals who vote to put the government in power. Our role
is to ensure that voters or citizens receive the benefits they intended
and that what they receive shows that their government cares and
provides them with what is right.
This is our responsibility because, by their nature, businesspeople,
being in business, are primarily focused on making a profit. This profit
can be obtained through both legal and illegal means, sometimes
through unethical means such as harming the consumer. Therefore,
the FCC ensures that these things do not happen, ensuring that
business thrives to attract more investors to our country.
Now, that is what you will hear from us. We hope that when you leave
this seminar with the knowledge you have gained, you will use your
platforms to educate Tanzanians so that together we can ensure that
business operations are fair and adhere to the accepted principles
according to the laws, regulations, and procedures of conducting
business in a free-market.
Dear Editors, through today's meeting, you will have three main
topics. The first will be the combat against counterfeit goods. It is
clear to all of you that the Sixth Phase Government is committed to
encouraging investors to come and invest in our country. Now, when
there is investment, especially in the industrial and production
sectors, you must be sure that the investment will yield the expected
8

profit. To achieve this, the business environment in our country must
be safe and adhere to international business principles. Therefore,
we, at the FCC, work towards this goal to attract more investors and
ensure that existing ones can conduct business without disturbance
from their competitors. However, we also need to prevent the
proliferation of counterfeit goods.
In this seminar, you will also be informed about counterfeit goods in
terms of concepts, types, identification, and their effects on our
country's economy. All these efforts go hand in hand in strengthening
competitive trade and ensuring that counterfeit goods do not enter or
are produced in the country, thereby preventing the failure of
investments and protecting investors from potential harm.
Dear Editors, I would like to take this opportunity to inform you that
the FCC has opened offices in the Lake Zone in Mwanza, located in
the PSSSF building, second floor, Kenyatta Road. In the Northern
Zone, we have an office in Arusha at AICC, Serengeti building, fifth
floor. Additionally, in the Southern Highlands Zone in Mbeya, our
office is located in the NSSF building, ground floor, Sisimba Street,
Karume Road. The main purpose of opening these offices is to bring
services closer to the people. Therefore, I urge you to use your
expertise and professional tools to help us inform the Tanzanian
public about the existence of these offices and the responsibilities we
carry out in accordance with the law.
After saying that, I would like to conclude by urging you to continue
adhering to professionalism and ethical standards in your profession
9

as you serve Tanzanians and all development stakeholders. Let us,
together, support the efforts made by the government to bring
development to our nation.
I wish you a successful seminar, and I now declare this seminar
officially open.
Thank you very much for listening!
10
